steps.title: Configure Application Metadata
steps.description: Establish package identification and application configurations for offline operation.

steps.title: Configure Gradle Build Scripts
steps.description: Set up Gradle build configuration compatible with Android SDK 34 and Java 8 without third-party dependencies.

steps.title: Define Android Manifest
steps.description: Register application activities, orientations, and custom launcher theme in AndroidManifest.xml.

steps.title: Define Design Values and Colors
steps.description: Create colors, themes, styles, and text resources for an elegant, cohesive material user interface.

steps.title: Create Note Data Model
steps.description: Develop Note entity supporting titles, contents, categories, color badges, timestamps, and pin flags.

steps.title: Implement Local Statistics and Calculation Engine
steps.description: Implement local Java logic for live word count, character count, and reading duration calculations.

steps.title: Develop Local JSON Storage System
steps.description: Implement native offline JSON persistence manager using internal sandboxed storage files.

steps.title: Design Note Editor Layout
steps.description: Construct responsive layout with title input, body editor, color palettes, and real-time statistics counters.

steps.title: Design Main Dashboard Layout
steps.description: Create dashboard layout with search bar, category chips, notes list, statistics summary banner, and FAB button.

steps.title: Implement Note Editor Controller
steps.description: Write NoteEditorActivity with dynamic category assignment, color badge selection, live word counts, and save handling.

steps.title: Implement Dashboard Controller
steps.description: Write MainActivity featuring note listing, pin toggling, real-time search filtering, category filtering, and deletion.

steps.title: Building QuickNotes
steps.description: Assemble and verify offline application components into the final debug release.
